title.en: OpenAI holds first DevDay, unveiling GPT-4 Turbo, custom GPTs, and a platform strategy
title.zhHans: OpenAI 召开首届 DevDay，发布 GPT-4 Turbo、自定义 GPT 和平台化战略

searchSummary.en: OpenAI DevDay (November 2023) unveiled GPT-4 Turbo, custom GPTs, and the GPT Store. How one event reshaped the AI developer ecosystem and set OpenAI’s product direction.
searchSummary.zhHans: OpenAI DevDay（2023 年 11 月）发布了 GPT-4 Turbo、自定义 GPT 和 GPT 商店。一场活动如何重塑了 AI 开发者生态、设定了 OpenAI 的产品方向。

summary.en: On November 6, 2023, OpenAI held its first developer conference, DevDay. CEO Sam Altman announced GPT-4 Turbo (128K context, 2-3x cheaper), the GPT Store for custom AI assistants, DALL-E 3 API integration, and voice/image APIs. With 100 million weekly active users and 92% of Fortune 500 companies on the platform, the event marked OpenAI's transition from a research lab to a full-fledged platform company.
summary.zhHans: 2023 年 11 月 6 日，OpenAI 举办了首届开发者大会 DevDay。CEO Sam Altman 宣布了 GPT-4 Turbo（128K 上下文、价格更低 2-3 倍）、用于自定义 AI 助手的 GPT Store、DALL-E 3 API 集成以及语音/图像 API。拥有 1 亿周活跃用户和 92% 的财富 500 强公司使用其平台，此次活动标志着 OpenAI 从研究实验室向全面平台公司的转变。

narrative.en: OpenAI DevDay 2023 was a coming-out party for OpenAI as a platform company. The announcements were substantial: GPT-4 Turbo extended context from 8K to 128K tokens (roughly 300 pages of text), reduced pricing by 2-3x for developers, and updated knowledge to April 2023. The GPT Store concept allowed users to create and share custom versions of ChatGPT for specific purposes, with revenue sharing promised for popular creators. DALL-E 3 was integrated into the API, and new voice and vision capabilities were opened to developers. The event showed OpenAI shifting strategy: rather than just selling access to models, it was building an ecosystem where third-party developers could create value on top of its platform. DevDay was also notable for what it foreshadowed: the GPT Store concept, while not immediately successful, anticipated the AI app marketplace model that would mature later. The event's timing was dramatic — just 11 days later, Sam Altman would be fired by the same board whose members were in the audience at DevDay.
narrative.zhHans: OpenAI DevDay 2023 是 OpenAI 作为平台公司的亮相派对。公告内容丰富：GPT-4 Turbo 将上下文从 8K 扩展到 128K tokens（约 300 页文本），价格降低了 2-3 倍，知识更新至 2023 年 4 月。GPT Store 概念允许用户为特定目的创建和共享 ChatGPT 的自定义版本，并为热门创作者承诺收入分成。DALL-E 3 被集成到 API 中，新的语音和视觉能力向开发者开放。该活动展示了 OpenAI 的战略转变：不仅仅是售卖模型访问权，而是构建一个第三方开发者可以在其平台上创造价值的生态系统。DevDay 还因其预示的内容而引人注目：GPT Store 概念虽然在当时不是立即成功，但预见了后来成熟的 AI 应用市场模式。该事件的时机具有戏剧性——仅仅 11 天后，Sam Altman 就被同一个董事会的成员解雇了，而这些人当时就在 DevDay 的观众席中。

description.en: Reduced GPT-4 API pricing by 2-3x, making advanced AI accessible to more developers. GPT Store concept anticipated the AI app marketplace model. Marked OpenAI's transition from research lab to platform company.
description.zhHans: 将 GPT-4 API 定价降低 2-3 倍，使更多开发者能够使用先进 AI。GPT Store 概念预见了 AI 应用市场模式。标志着 OpenAI 从研究实验室向平台公司的转变。
